# Greenleaf Pharmacy third-party source record

All assets in `poly_haven/` and `materials/poly_haven/` were downloaded at
1K resolution from [Poly Haven](https://polyhaven.com/) on 29 July 2026.
They are available under
[CC0 1.0 Universal](https://polyhaven.com/license). Individual authors and
source pages are recorded in `docs/implementation/assets_reference.md`.

The shared sanitary fixtures used by this interior are from
[Toilets by loafbrr_1](https://opengameart.org/content/toilets) on
OpenGameArt. The pack is CC0, UV-mapped, and uses authored 1K textures.
Only one toilet, one sink, their required maps, and the supplied license
readme are retained in the repository.
